For \(l_2: y=x+m+2\), intersections with the parabola satisfy
\[
x^2+2x-3=x+m+2 \implies x^2+x-(m+5)=0.
\]
Its discriminant is
\[
\Delta_2=1+4(m+5)=21+4m.
\]
For \(l_1\), the discriminant is also
\[
\Delta_1=9+4(3+m)=21+4m.
\]
Since both lines have slope \(\pm 1\),
\[
AC=\sqrt2\sqrt{21+4m},\qquad BD=\sqrt2\sqrt{21+4m}.
\]
Thus
\[
AC\cdot BD=2(21+4m)=26,
\]
so
\[
21+4m=13 \implies m=-2.
\]
\[
\boxed{-2}
\]
